info.title: Selecting a product and installation mode

abstract.para: In this step, you select the product and its installation mode.

topic.para: Select &productname; &productnumber; for installation and choose its installation mode:

listitem.para: The file system is writable. This mode offers maximum flexibility.
The root file system is write-protected. Updates are applied atomically to a new snapshot. The snapshot becomes active after a reboot.

topic.para: Read and accept the license to continue.

tip.title: Installer language and keyboard
tip.para: Click the arrow menu in the top right corner and select Installer options to change the language and keyboard layout used by the installer. The language can only be changed on local installations. If you are using a Web browser for a remote installation, configure the preferred content language in the browser settings and reload the installer.
